Quest.summary: The Harbourmaster's Ledger went missing somewhere in The Gullet Caves. Find it and bring it back.
Quest.title: Recover the Harbourmaster's Ledger

Quest.summary: There are too many Smugglers about, worst of all around The Undertow Deep. Defeat 3 of them, wherever you find them.
Quest.title: Too many Smugglers

Quest.summary: A Grizzled Conger Eel has been troubling anyone who goes near The Gullet Caves. Put an end to it.
Quest.title: Wanted: the Grizzled Conger Eel

Quest.summary: No one has a true map of The Undertow Deep. Walk every room of it and come back.
Quest.title: Chart The Undertow Deep

Quest.summary: The Smuggler's Tally went missing somewhere in The Brine Halls. Find it and bring it back.
Quest.title: The lost Smuggler's Tally

Enemy.description: A grey eel as thick as your arm, all teeth, lunging from a flooded crack.
Enemy.name: Grizzled Conger Eel

QuestItem.description: Its pages are stuck together with salt, but the figures are legible.
QuestItem.name: Harbourmaster's Ledger

QuestItem.description: A knotted cord, each knot a debt. Several people would pay to see it burned.
QuestItem.name: Smuggler's Tally

Clue.text: A half-finished map, its edges blank, labelled in a careful hand: The Undertow Deep.
A letter, never sent: "I hid the Smuggler's Tally in The Brine Halls. Whoever finds this, take it to the harbour."

log: You stand at The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 3 notices pinned to it.
You take down the notice: Recover the Harbourmaster's Ledger.
You take down the notice: Too many Smugglers.
You take down the notice: Wanted: the Grizzled Conger Eel.

ambient: A cart rattles past and away down the road.
Someone calls a greeting from a window, then thinks better of it.
rooms.description: A gate of grey driftwood, bound with iron and left open. Roads leave from here along the coast and inland.
features: A gatekeeper's stool, empty, with a half-mended net draped over it.
rooms.name: The Town Gate

ambient: A shutter bangs somewhere above you.
Gulls squabble on a rooftop.
rooms.description: A street of fish-scale shingles and blue doors, every one of them shut.
rooms.name: Salt-Stained Street

ambient: A shutter bangs somewhere above you.

rooms.description: Tall narrow houses lean together over the street, their upper floors almost touching.
features: A rain barrel with a dead crab floating in it.

ambient: Somebody laughs too loudly at a corner table.
The fire spits salt.

features: A figurehead over the hearth, her painted eyes following the door.
rooms.name: Salt-Stained Tavern
